caption: The drawing depicts two representations of the same garment on a plain, light beige background. On the left side, there is a black line drawing of a cape-like garment with a scalloped decorative border along the edges and collar, and two long, hanging panels at the front, also bordered with a scalloped trim. On the right side, positioned higher and larger, there is a detailed colored drawing of the same garment rendered in a rich dark blue shade, likely representing velvet or a similar fabric. The scalloped edges are embellished with intricate patterns in a lighter, possibly gold or beige color, indicating lace or embroidered trim. The garment appears draped and layered, and the colored version has shading to give a sense of texture and volume. Both representations are set against a blank, unadorned background with no additional objects present.
title: Blue Velvet Dolman
